name: Add COUNTROWS measures
description: Add missing COUNTROWS measures to every datamart table in specific schema
statement:
/*
Add missing COUNTROWS measures to every datamart table in specific schema
*/

DECLARE @Folder sysname
SET @Folder = CFG.GET_PARAM_VALUE('MEASURE_DEFAULT_DISPLAY_FOLDER')

INSERT INTO CFG.MEASURES([TableID], [Name], [StatementTAB], [OLAP_DisplayFolder], [IsHidden])
SELECT T.TableID, 'count_rows ({TableName})', 'COUNTROWS(''{TableName}'')', @Folder, 0
FROM
	CFG.TABLES T
WHERE
	T.SchemaID = :1 AND
	T.TableTypeID IN (7,8,9,10) AND
	NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CFG.MEASURES M WHERE M.TableID = T.TableID AND M.Name = 'count_rows ({TableName})')
